title: consistent words
rule: Use the same command words in every menu, dialog, or flow for the same action; add a noun when the verb alone is ambiguous.
pass_when: The same action uses the same words across menus, dialogs, and flows; a noun is added when the verb alone is ambiguous.
fail_when: The same action is labeled differently in different places, or an ambiguous verb stands alone.
overview: The same action uses the same words everywhere; add a noun if needed.
apply_when: The same action appears in menus, dialogs, or multiple flows.
not_when: Truly different actions that only sound similar and need distinct names.
agent_hint: Reuse the same command words across surfaces; add a noun if ambiguous.
description: Identical actions should share identical wording across menus, dialogs, and flows so recognition transfers. When a bare verb is ambiguous, add a noun so the target is clear without changing the core verb. Relabeling the same action in different places, or leaving an ambiguous verb alone, breaks learning. Keep distinct names only when the underlying actions truly differ in what they do.
